messages:
Jamal: Quick question
bout the year-end shutdown
nd carryover. I just got called up for mandatory military training from 2026-12-22 to 2027-01-05. Does that count against my PTO or the blackout?
Maria - People Ops: Oh thanks for the heads up, Jamal. For mandatory military duty we have an exemption path. Do you have official orders or a training enrollment notice? We'll need that to file the blackout exception. :pray:
Jamal: Yes 
ttached to the HR portal now. I can also email the PDF to people-ops@redwood.ai if easier.
Alex (Eng Manager): I can cover the critical deliverables those dates. We can reassign the on-call week — no problem from my side. :+1:
Maria - People Ops: Perfect. Please email the orders with subject line: "Blackout exemption request - Jamal". Once we have it we'll mark the shutdown dates as a protected absence so they don't reduce your carryover or accruals.
Jamal: Should I still submit PTO for the travel days on either side, or leave them blank while you process?
Maria - People Ops: Leave them unbooked for now. We'll retroactively protect the mandatory training days. If you want paid travel days around the training, request them as PTO and note "travel for military training"; we'll fast-track approval.
Lisa: Also FYI payroll needs a copy to adjust accruals if necessary. People Ops will ping payroll once you send the doc.
Jamal: Sent the email moments ago. Subject: "Blackout exemption request - Jamal - military training". Attachment: orders_2026.pdf
people-ops-bot: Request received. Ticket #PO-5633 created. Please allow 1-2 business days for review.
Maria - People Ops: Got it, Jamal. I
lready flagged payroll and your manager. We'll confirm by EOD tomorrow and update your AbsencePortal entry.
Alex (Eng Manager): If you want, I can approve tentative unpaid leave so calendar is accurate while People Ops reviews. Ping me if you want that.
Jamal: Thanks everyone 
ppreciate the quick help. :heart:
file_notes: exemption for mandatory military training overlapping year-end shutdown
